blind.B1: No. GSE123961 is DG vs SVZ Nes-GFP+ cells from standard-housed mice (S2.2.p1; all titles *_STD_*, growth_protocol 'Standard housing'). Running-wheel exercise (S2.1, S2.6) is measured by counts, flow and westerns, not sequenced here. No sample carries the exercise factor; the series is a non-exercise region comparison.
blind.B2: DG vs SVZ, 5 vs 4 samples after removal of one low-depth sample per experiment (S4.4.11.p1). No exercise comparison.
blind.B3: DG and SVZ come from the same standard-housed animals (S2.2.p1), so tissue is repeated within animals. Titles end in POS1-POS5 (DG POS1-5, SVZ POS1-4) and could be the animal key, but packet A found no candidate key. Irrelevant to an exercise contrast since none exists.
blind.B4: Paper does not say joint or pairwise. It says edgeR CPM filter then lmFit/topTags (S4.4.11.p1).
blind.B5: 'only significantly (adjusted p < 0.05) differentially expressed transcripts were used' (S4.4.11.p1); no fold-change cutoff. Enriched = mean above the all-group average; the text reports 30.2% DG-unique and 26.4% SVZ-unique transcripts (S2.2.p2), no DEG count.

checks.evidence: No exercise arm: all 9 titles STD, DG 5 / SVZ 4 (packet A); paper S2.2.p1, S4.4.10.1.p1.
tissue DG 5 / SVZ 4 matches GEO; the removed low-depth sample is already absent from GEO (HANDBACK deviation).
Refused before modelling. DG/SVZ share animals (S2.2.p1) and the POS number may be the unit; if the DG vs SVZ comparison is ever run, test POS as a blocking key (not in the request).
log2 CPM values -5.1 to 14.1, non-integer, 14477 genes; limma route recommended, consistent with GEO data_processing.
Recorded as FDR 0.05, no FC cutoff, S4.4.11.p1; matches B5.
No ours-vs-paper numbers claimed; HANDBACK says none computed and the paper gives no count.
'No exercise arm' is true and established from all sample titles, growth protocol and the paper's methods, not from one narrow search.

summary: 该系列只有标准饲养小鼠的DG与SVZ比较，没有运动组，拒绝运行的理由成立且依据充分。阈值、矩阵类型和样本数均与论文一致。无阻断或主要问题。
